If you’re still looking to land a set of AirPods Pro 3, Amazon’s particularly notable 25% price drop is still flying, but we are kicking off today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break with another chance to score all AirPods Max 2 back at $100 off and this 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro at $300 off. We also have Anker’s latest Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe Car Charger Mount at 25% off, and the ongoing Best Buy Back to School sale with loads of deals on tech, dorm gear, smart home, and more. Scope it out below.

Amazon’s nearly 25% price drop on AirPods Pro 3 still live, could jump back up any minute

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $119 (Reg. $179 new) – Renewed Premium

Last week’s Apple Shopping Event delivered one of the best deals to date on AirPods Pro 3. That sale, and the Pro 3 discount that came along with it is now over at Best Buy where it has instead updated its 2026 Black to School sale, but Amazon’s nearly 25% price drop on AirPods Pro 3 is still live…for now.

Amazon is still offering Apple’s latest AirPods Pro 3 down at $189.99 shipped.

Regularly $249, this is just shy of 25% off the list price, roughly $10 under the Black Friday in July deal, and among the lowest prices we have have tracked since release.

M5 MacBook Pro back in stock at Apple refurb for $1,439 if you’re quick

Update: The official Apple Refurb Store now has the Space Black 512GB M5 MacBook Pro back in stock at the same $1,439– this offer will likely not last for long.

The official Apple refurb store now has the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 512GB model back in stock at $1,439. This is a seriously notable opportunity to land a seriously low price on a current-gen machine – the most affordable MacBook Pro you can buy new from Apple carries a $1,999 list price.

Apple is now offering its 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB SSD in silver down at $1,439 shipped. This offer is not likely to last for very long – the Space Black sold out completely in a matter of a few hours max.

When Apple released the latest M5 Pro and M5 Max machines earlier this year, it nixed the 512GB storage tier on the M5 models. This effectively hiked up the price of entry on the lineup, which then jumped even higher after the recent price increases – the lineup now starts at $1,999.

Official Apple refurb store offering most affordable M5 MacBook Pro at $300 off

Deals on the most affordable end of the M5 lineup have been much harder to come by. Apple’s official refurb store however, is serving up a compelling offer on the most affordable M5 MacBook Pro it still sells with the 16GB/1TB configuration at $300 off the list price.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB SSD down at $1,699 shipped.

This Apple Watch Ultra 3 config is now nearly $130 off at Amazon

We caught a chance at some notable deals across the Apple Watch Ultra 3 lineup over the last week and during this past weekend’s Apple Shopping Event. But none better than the nearly $130 price drop on this Ultra 3 configuration, and it is now live again over at Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the Blue/Bright Blue Trail Loop down at $669.97 shipped.

This is a regularly $799 configuration seeing a solid $129 price drop here again today. This is the same deal we spotted late last week, before it went completely out of stock only to make a triumphant return here today.

Deals on Apple Watch Ultra 3 have popped up here and there over the last year or so, but have been relatively rare and not often better than $99 off. Best Buy was offering a series of configurations at $49 off as part of its recent sale event, but this special offer on the Natural model is a whole lot better than that.

Outside of the Prime Day discount and a hangover deal shortly after, this is the lowest price we have tracked to date on this model – it comes within $20 of the limited-time Prime Day offer and is not likely to last for very long.

  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Blue Trail Loop $670 (Reg. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ MilaneseLoop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

Anker’s latest Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe Car Charger Mount now up to 25% off at Amazon

As part of the ongoing Anker Back to School sale we detailed yesterday and the return of all-time low pricing on its 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe Charging Station, we are also tracking a solid discount on the brand’s latest Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe Car Charger Mount at just over $67.

The official Anker Amazon storefront is now offering its Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe Compatible Wireless Car Charger Mount down at $67.49 shipped.

This model landed as part of late 2025 Prime charging lineup to deliver the brand’s latest and greatest in 25W smartphone action in your ride. It carries a $90 list price, is now 25% less than that, and has dropped a touch lower than the recent $70 summer sale pricing we have been tracking.

Sporting a modern black with silver trim look alongside a subtle blue glow around the bottom of the MagSafe charging pad, this model delivers Qi2 25W wireless charging and AirCool powered by aerospace-grade TEC to keep your device at optimal temperatures while on the road. Anker says this combination is capable of taking your “iPhone 17 Pro to 50% in just 22 minutes.”

With support for adjustable viewing angles as well as portrait and landscape, it ships with he mount itself, an Anker Car Adapter, a 3.3-foot USB-C cable to connect it up, a cord organizer, and a couple cable holders to keep everything clean and tidy.

Anker’s latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe Charging Station now back down to Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

Best Buy updates 2026 Back to School sale: TVs under $500, Bose $130 off, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen, much more

All AirPods Max 2 colorways back at $100 off for this week’s 4-day Apple sale

While Amazon has now dropped the price on AirPods Pro 3 even lower as part of the end of week Apple sales running right now, the $100 discount on Apple’s latest AirPods Max 2 is alive and well.

Amazon is now offering all five colors of Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 over-ear headphones down at $449 shipped.

Regularly $549, this is $100 off the list price and the best price we can find.

This weekend’s deal is a carry over from the Black Friday and July sale. While select colors did recently jump back up in price for a short time, they are all now back at $100 off the list.

The only time we have seen Apple’s all-new, next-generation AirPods Max 2 sell for less than we are here today was during the late June Prime Day sale – you’re otherwise looking at the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon since release earlier this year.

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Spigen’s mini MagSafe iPhone backpack/EDC pouch now down at $27
  • Rare price drops knock 20% off Apple Sport Bands and Loops at Amazon this week
  • Grab a set of Matte Black Beats Solo Buds down as low as $41 today
  • Anker’s 5-port Nano Travel Adapter keeps you powered up in ‘over 200 countries’ down at $20
  • David Pogue’s ‘Apple: The First 50 Years’ hardcover book now just $26 at Amazon (Orig. $50)
  • Latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable in black back down at $18 Prime shipped all-time low (40% off)
  • Store your Apple Watch band collection the elegant way: Twelve South TimePorter now under $23
  • UGREEN’s 65W Nexode Air is one of the smallest chargers we’ve seen, now just $21.50 at nearly 50% off
  • This DOCKCASE SSD enclosure shows drive health and has power-loss protection – now just $30 (All-time low)
  • Rare deal drops Belkin’s latest UltraCharge 2-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger to $54 (All colors)

Anker’s 2026 Back to School sale drops chargers, power banks, and Qi2.2 gear back to Prime Day lows from just $10 (46% off)

Anker is now running a Back to School sale across its lineup of accessories, with promo code SCHOOL20 taking 20% off sitewide on chargers, power banks, cables, charging stations, and more. The brand’s official Amazon storefront is matching many of those offers as well, while also serving up a few additional discounts of its own across popular models. There are deals on everything from compact Nano chargers and multi-port laptop bricks to MagSafe charging gear, power banks, and other everyday accessories. Many of the Amazon offers are bringing prices back down to the same all-time lows we tracked during the recent Prime Day sale, giving you another shot at those best-ever prices without having to wait for the next major shopping event. If you’re putting together a new school or work setup, or simply need to refresh your charging gear, there are plenty of solid Anker deals worth checking out right now.

Anker’s 2026 Back to School sale is now live

The brand’s official Amazon storefront has added a handful of new deals to the mix, and we’ve highlighted those below along with some of the existing offers for you to check out.

  • Anker 45W Nano charger with Smart display $26 (Reg. $40)
  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (Reg. $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 Charging Station with display $135 (Reg. $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch control $116 (Reg. $150)
  • Anker 140W 4-port laptop charger with display $65 (Reg. $90)
  • Anker 25,000mAh 165W laptop power bank with dual USB-C cables $105 (Reg. $120)
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 docking station with detachable 6-in-1 hub $112 (Reg. $150)
  • Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 charging station $72 (Reg. $90)
  • Anker Nano ultra-slim 5,000mAh MagSafe power bank $44 (Reg. $55)
  • Code SCHOOL20
  • And even more…

Land a FREE $25 Best Buy credit with MacBook Neo, or grab one at $120 off via official Apple refurb store

Price hike or otherwise, deals on MacBook Neo have been all but non-existent. And while the price of the machine has gone up, it remains the most affordable current-generation MacBook you can buy and there are ways to save right now – Best Buy is offering a FREE $25 gift card with brand new units as part of its latest Apple Shopping Event and you can score them at up to $120 off via the Apple Certified Refurbished Store.

Best Buy launched a wide-ranging 4-day Apple Shopping Event yesterday, and while select gear is lower at Amazon, it does have the best deal going on brand new MacBook Neo models right now:

  • MacBook Neo + FREE $25 Best Buy gift card from $699

However, the price right now is being served up over at the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store. The price on these machine did just go up, but if you’re looking to score one at the lowest price around, this is the place to be:

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)

The 256GB model is clearly just dropping back down to the former MSRP and the 512GB is now $20 less than the old list price, but it is what it is and the price hikes aren’t going anywhere anytime soon.
